scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix apps/shell ci && npm --prefix apps/projects ci
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n shell,projects -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix apps/shell run dev" "npm --prefix apps/projects start"
scripts.build: npm run check:routes && npm --prefix apps/shell run build && npm --prefix apps/projects run build:prod && node scripts/assemble.mjs
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/shell run lint && npm --prefix apps/projects run lint
